B13_00.process: Restraining actin-driven membrane protrusions to limit cell spreading and migration.
B13_00.tissue: Most cell types, notably epithelial and immune cells.

B13_02.process: Formation of inhibitory synapses in neural circuits.

B13_03.process: Limiting centriole duplication to maintain normal centrosome number.

B13_04.process: Preparing synaptic vesicles for neurotransmitter release.
B13_04.disease: Early-onset epileptic encephalopathies and movement disorders.

B13_05.process: Formation of the synapse between nerve and muscle.
B13_05.disease: Congenital myasthenic syndromes and myasthenia gravis.
B13_05.tissue: Motor neurons and skeletal muscle fibres.

B13_06.process: Loosening of cell-cell tight junctions, reducing tissue barrier function.
B13_06.disease: Inflammatory barrier disease, leaky gut, and cancer metastasis.

B13_07.process: Controlling actin filament length in the cytoskeleton.
B13_07.tissue: Muscle, red blood cells and neurons.

B13_08.process: Regulation of actin filament growth during cell movement.
B13_08.tissue: Most cell types, notably migrating and immune cells.

B13_09.process: Restraining leading-edge protrusions to limit cell migration.
B13_09.disease: Cancer invasion and neural wiring defects.
B13_09.tissue: Migrating cells, neurons, endothelial and tumour cells.

B13_10.process: Assembly of the receiving side of neuronal synapses.

B13_11.process: Restraining formation of thin actin protrusions in cells.

B13_12.process: Suppression of inflammasome activation in innate immunity.
B13_12.disease: Periodic fever syndromes, gout, atherosclerosis and neuroinflammation.
B13_12.tissue: Innate immune cells, including macrophages and microglia.

B13_13.process: Limiting microtubule growth to keep the cytoskeleton dynamic.

B13_14.process: Restraining synapse formation in the nervous system.

B13_15.process: Regulation of membrane fusion machinery assembly.
B13_15.disease: Infantile epilepsy, paroxysmal dyskinesia, Parkinson's disease and lysosomal disorders.
B13_15.tissue: Neurons and most cell types' lysosomal system.

B13_16.process: Formation of stress granules during cellular stress responses.

B13_17.process: Regulation of protein complex assembly and aggregation.
B13_17.disease: Protein aggregation diseases such as neurodegeneration.

B13_18.process: Regulation of inflammasome activation by cytosolic DNA in innate immunity.

B13_19.process: Assembly of the mitotic spindle during cell division.
